critical_gates.name: Factual integrity
critical_gates.fail_if: Invents or materially distorts product facts, proof, metrics, testimonials, deadlines, guarantees, competitor facts, or customer quotes.

critical_gates.name: Evidence discipline
critical_gates.fail_if: Presents unsupported/provisional claim as established fact or hides material evidence limitation.

critical_gates.name: Causal discipline
critical_gates.fail_if: Infers mechanism causality from observational metric or bundle experiment without identification.

critical_gates.name: No manipulative fabrication
critical_gates.fail_if: Creates fake scarcity/social proof/urgency or deceptive comparative claim.

critical_gates.name: Measurement validity
critical_gates.fail_if: Treats a platform proxy as a direct latent psychological measurement without validation.

scored_dimensions.name: Context understanding
scored_dimensions.anchor_3: Mostly correct with some generic assumptions.

scored_dimensions.name: Cross-core reasoning
scored_dimensions.anchor_3: Multiple factors but weak interaction handling.
scored_dimensions.anchor_5: Uses relevant cross-core edges/conflicts without forced connections.

scored_dimensions.name: Value strategy
scored_dimensions.anchor_5: Relative value tied to goal, alternative, sacrifice and evidence.

scored_dimensions.name: Claim/proof fit
scored_dimensions.anchor_5: Claims appropriately scoped and paired with diagnostic evidence.

scored_dimensions.name: Trust & objection handling
scored_dimensions.anchor_5: Targets the actual belief/trust gap with bounded support.

scored_dimensions.name: Message architecture
scored_dimensions.anchor_5: Sequence reflects diagnosed mechanism, evidence and channel needs.

scored_dimensions.name: Language & audience fit
scored_dimensions.anchor_5: Audience-grounded wording, register, specificity and common ground.

scored_dimensions.name: CTA/friction fit
scored_dimensions.anchor_5: Clear next step matched to value, autonomy and actual friction.

scored_dimensions.name: Uncertainty honesty
scored_dimensions.anchor_5: Uncertainty and non-inferences are material, precise and useful.

scored_dimensions.name: Channel/brand adaptation
scored_dimensions.anchor_5: Structure and language fit medium, placement and brand constraints.

scored_dimensions.name: Copy quality
scored_dimensions.anchor_5: Clear, specific, persuasive, credible and non-formulaic for the case.

pass_policy.case_pass: All applicable critical gates PASS; no scored dimension below 3; mean scored dimension >= 4.0.
pass_policy.case_pass_with_warnings: All applicable critical gates PASS; no dimension below 2; mean >= 3.5; at least one remediable weakness.
pass_policy.case_fail: Any critical gate FAIL, or mean < 3.5, or a material required expectation absent.
pass_policy.set_pass: No critical failures; >=90% case PASS/PASS_WITH_WARNINGS; mean dimension score >=4.0; adversarial set requires 100% critical-gate pass.

scoring_note: Scores are evaluation rubric scores, not empirical effect sizes or probabilities.
